statement: letI := Classical.propDecidable; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x H : ℕ, 1 ≤ H → H ≤ x → (((Finset.Ioc x (2*x)).filter fun n => Even n ∧ ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p<q ∧ n^2+1=p*q ∧ q-p≤H).card : ℝ) ≤ C*H

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 方法与自然推广 · 近等双素因子的计数上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH methods and extensions · Bound semiprimes with nearly equal prime factors

brief.zh: 对 $1\le H'\le x$ 证明真半素数中 $q-p\le H'$ 的参数数目 $\ll H'$。由 S04 有 $h\le H'/2,\ v\ll (H')^2/x$，若有解则 $(H')^2\ge8x$。固定 $v$ 时 $h\ll\sqrt{xv}$，由同余至多有 $O(\rho(v)(1+\sqrt{x/v}))$ 个。用 S05 得 $O((H')^2/x+H')$。取 $H'=H$，此带只花 $O(x/\log^2 x)$。
brief.en: Use the conic parameter to bound v by the squared gap divided by x. Then sum over roots modulo v.
